description:
List a company's public contract awards, ordered by publication date,
newest first: the REST API's GET /v1/companies/{slug}/contracts.

Use it for one company's awards; a name is searched as in company_history:
several matches return {ambiguous: true, candidates}, none returns
{error, suggested_companies}.

Returns JSON {company_slug, nif, count, offset, next_offset, contracts:
[{source, award_id, published, awarded_on, buyer, title, lot, amount_eur,
cpv, notice_url, minor}], sources}. Awards come from Spanish and EU public
procurement notices, matched by tax ID; awards published in multiple
notices are listed once. nif null means we hold no tax ID for the company,
not that it won nothing; count 0 is not proof it never won a contract.
Legal-entity winners only; TED notices in the pre-eForms format
(January-June 2024) are not included.

Read-only; one request per call. Requires the Basic plan or higher and an
API key in the X-API-Key header (https://bormeapi.com/account).

company.description: Company slug as returned by search_companies or company_history (e.g. vaz-metales-sl), or a name to search.
company.title: Company

date_from.description: Optional earliest publication date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2024-01-01.
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: Optional latest publication date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2024-12-31.
date_to.title: Date To

min_amount.description: Optional minimum award amount in EUR, e.g. 100000.
min_amount.title: Min Amount

offset.description: Awards to skip, integer 0-10000 (default 0); pass the previous page's next_offset, e.g. 50.
offset.title: Offset

source.description: Optional, one or more of placsp, navarra, ted separated by commas, e.g. ted; omit for all.
source.title: Source

name: company_contracts
title: A company's public contract awards
